P01.rationale: No founder portrait or human anchor appears anywhere on the page; only text and abstract data visualizations are present.

P05.rationale: The client (Conesso GmbH) is named and framed in a dedicated section with clear context, though not as a photographic portrait but as a textual case study block.

P07.rationale: A testimonial-style quote from the founder appears at the bottom right of the dark panel, serving as minimal social proof.

P10.rationale: The large '04' numeral in the top-right corner functions as an oversized decorative typographic element anchoring the layout.

P11.rationale: Real data visualizations are present: before/after time comparisons (30 min → 2 min) and cost-math breakdowns (copywriting per asset).

P12.rationale: The page is densely filled with structured content across both columns, resembling a magazine editorial layout.

P13.rationale: A subtle off-white paper texture underlies the entire page, providing atmospheric depth without overwhelming readability.

P14.rationale: No full-bleed photo is used on this page; therefore, no treatment for overlaid text readability applies.

P16.rationale: No device or product mockup (e.g., phone, laptop, book) appears anywhere on the page to enhance credibility.

N07.rationale: Imagery is entirely typographic and abstract; no photos are used, so genericness does not apply but also doesn’t add specificity.

N08.rationale: Minimal dead whitespace exists — margins are tight and content fills most of the page area effectively.

N10.rationale: No text sits on busy photos without scrim because there are no photos at all; all overlays occur on solid color fields.
